title: Kicked Crispy Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A crowd-pleasing Uruguayan dish featuring crispy beef skewers with a sour and glassy-jelly sauce, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Dip each skewer into the beaten egg and then coat in almond flour, shaking off excess.
Double-fry the skewers in hot oil at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Place the fried skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 10-12 minutes, until cooked through.
While the skewers are baking, prepare the glassy-jelly sauce by melting the grana padano cheese in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Serve the crispy beef skewers with the sour and glassy-jelly sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
